newsitem.title: USA: ARCHER DANIELS LIFTS STAKE IN IBP TO 7.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ARCHER DANIELS LIFTS STAKE IN IBP TO 7.2 PCT.

text.p: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co said Monday it raised its stake in IBP Inc to 6,652,800 common shares or 7.227 percent from six percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Decatur, Ill., food conglomerate said its latest transactions include the purchase of 2,108,600 common shares between July 15 and August 8 at prices ranging from $22.125 to $23.125 per share.
Archer-Daniels said it holds shares in the Dakota City, Neb., meat packing and processing company for investment purposes.
